newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - DEC 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - DEC 9.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
The busiest Christmas shopping spree in almost a decade has begun. A study by property consultants Healey & Baker has found that 23.5 billion stg will be spent by shoppers on gifts and revelry.
SHARES POISED TO STAGE A CLIMB-BACK

Political uncertainty at home and the prospect of an earlier than expected general election was expected to make today's trading volatile. Shares were expected to open higher in London after strong trading in Asian markets.

BAe TRIES AGAIN FOR A SLICE OF 100 BILLION STG DEAL In a bid to rejoin the battle for the lucrative 100 million stg contract to build the new generation of British and US jet fighter British Aerospace has opened negotiations with American aircraft manufacturer Boeing to collaborate on a future aircraft.

Queens Moat Houses the troubled hotels group, with debts of one billion stg, is understood to have sold its County hotels chain of 25 properties for approximately 100 million stg. For a full range of news monitoring services, phone BMC on
